about_the_game:
Raiders of Blackveil is a top-down pulse pounding roguelite that is all about mastering champions, combining synergistic perks and acquiring powerful loot. Take on the challenge alone or in a team of up to 3 players. Creating the best team-synergy is vital to success.  

Raiders of Blackveil is set in a dystopian industrial fantasy world where animals are oppressed by a human mega corporation called Blackveil. You will join the animal rebellion as they aim to thwart Blackveil’s attempt at enslaving nature and enforcing a mindless consumer society. 


CHOOSE YOUR CHAMPION

Select from a range of MOBA-inspired champions, each with unique abilities, playstyles, and personalities. Pick your role as a Tank, Damage Dealer, or Support. Gather your best mates, join the rebellion, and form the ultimate team to fight against Blackveil.


MASTER THE DRAFT

Draft a unique build from over 300 perks across 8 classic fantasy classes, each with unique effects and mechanics Choose between Mage, Assassin, Priest, Guardian, Monk, Druid, Warrior, and Warlock. Unlock class synergies through Duo Perks for outrageously satisfying combos.

HUNT FOR LOOT

Hunt and collect rare and powerful items. Precious currencies, equipment, trinkets and gadgets, all to fuel the efforts of the rebellion. Unique legendaries and mythic items with special effects, your load-out determines your effectiveness in battle!

WE WANT YOUR FEEDBACK

We are in it for the long haul! Raiders of Blackveil is our baby and we intend to see it mature. Join us on Discord and in Early Access and help shape Raiders of Blackveil as we grow! Wishlist now and you will be the first to know when Early Access is available!


Now go, rebel, the fight against Blackveil never stops, we cannot wait to see you combine insane perks with overpowered loot to take down those scumbags.

short_description: Join the rebellion against the evil cooperation Blackveil in this action-packed roguelite for 1-3 players. Select your MOBA-like champion, collect RPG-style loot and infiltrate Blackveil’s massive factory. Wreak havoc, and smuggle out loot to get INSANELY powerful!
